value.body: A reservation and ticketing executive books air tickets, hotels and packages for customers and handles date changes, cancellations and refunds. Employers include travel agencies, online travel companies, airline call centres and corporate travel desks. Much of the work happens on a global distribution system (GDS) — the booking software airlines and agents share.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: Any graduate or Class 12 with a ticketing course
items.note: BBA (Aviation or Tourism) and BTTM graduates often take this route

items.label: Common tools
items.value: GDS software (for example Amadeus, Sabre or Galileo), airline portals, Excel

items.label: Work pattern
items.value: Office or call-centre shifts; travel desks may run 24x7

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers usually complete a short GDS ticketing course and join a travel agency, online travel company or corporate travel desk as a trainee. Airline and travel call centres also recruit graduates with good spoken English.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Accuracy with names, dates and documents

value.title: At a glance
items: Common next roles: senior travel consultant, team lead, corporate travel manager.
Online self-booking has reduced simple ticketing work, so complex itineraries and service skills carry more weight.
Travel demand is seasonal and sensitive to economic shocks.
